title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Overview:

Within SSOE's Advanced Technology division, we design and deliver the electrical infrastructure behind some of the world's most advanced semiconductor and high\-tech manufacturing facilities. As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you'll serve as a technical leader responsible for developing innovative power distribution, grounding, lighting, and mission\-critical electrical systems that support complex manufacturing environments. You'll work closely with project teams and clients to solve challenging engineering problems, establish design direction, and ensure technical excellence throughout the project lifecycle. Our integrated, multidisciplinary approach provides the opportunity to influence facility\-wide design decisions while mentoring engineers and advancing best practices across the organization. If you're energized by technical leadership, complex facility design, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on projects shaping the future of technology, SSOE offers an environment where your expertise can thrive.  

We are seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our Advanced Technology team. In this position, you will lead the electrical systems design for complex semiconductor and high\-tech manufacturing facilities, mentor the next generation of engineers, and drive projects to completion. You will collaborate daily with specialists across every discipline, contributing to some of the most capital\-intensive and technically complex facilities on the planet. Your lead will play a central role in designing and delivering the electrical groundwork that powers advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities.

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. title: Staff Level III – Critical Power & Electromagnetic Threats
description:
**Job Title:**
==============

Staff Level III – Critical Power \& Electromagnetic Threats
**Location:**
=============

Knoxville, TN
**Job Summary and Description:**
================================

### **Summary**

### **The position is for an experienced engineer with expertise in power system simulation, data analysis, and design. The candidate will support research and development activities within the Critical Power \& Electromagnetic Threats Program and contribute to the execution of technical projects involving power system modeling, simulation, and analytics. The candidate must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance. Applicants with an active security clearance are preferred.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* ### **Perform power system analysis (time\-domain and frequency domain) using simulation tools such as EMTP\-RV, PowerWorld, PSS®E, OpenDSS, and related software.**
* ### **Design, implement, and validate power system simulation models and analytical methods.**
* ### **Support the development of new research capabilities and technical solutions for power system resilience and electromagnetic threat studies.**
* ### **Contribute technical expertise to project teams while collaborating with senior engineers, technical leaders, and subject matter experts.**
* ### **Assist in the execution of medium\-sized research projects and technical tasks, including schedule and budget tracking when assigned.**
* ### **Analyze and interpret large technical datasets and develop actionable insights and recommendations.**
* ### **Prepare technical reports, presentations, and research deliverables for internal and external stakeholders.**
* ### **Support member engagement activities, workshops, conferences, and technical meetings.**
* ### **Develop software tools, scripts, and automation capabilities as needed to support research objectives.**

title: Sales Engineer
description:
**SALES ENGINEER**

**Tulsa, Oklahoma \| Full\-Time, On\-Site \| 30% Travel**

**About Maccor**

Maccor designs and manufactures high\-performance battery and cell testing systems at our headquarters in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Since 1987, our equipment has supported customers working at the forefront of battery research, development, manufacturing, and product innovation.

We believe in building equipment around quality, performance, accuracy, and reliability. Our systems are manufactured in Tulsa, and we are proud to work with local vendors and build long\-term, sustainable relationships.

**About the Position**

Maccor is seeking a Sales Engineer to help develop new business while supporting and growing relationships with existing customers.

This isn't a typical sales position. You might talk with a battery chemist at 8:00 AM, a rocket scientist at 8:30 AM, and a product engineer at a Fortune 100 company at 9:00 AM. Our customers span virtually every industry involved in developing, manufacturing, or using batteries, which means the applications \- and the technical challenges \- are constantly changing.

The ideal candidate is technically curious, comfortable talking with engineers and scientists, and capable of translating a customer's testing requirements into the right Maccor solution.

You'll be selling technical equipment where performance, reliability, and long\-term value matter. Success requires understanding the customer's application, communicating technical capabilities clearly, and developing relationships based on trust rather than simply competing on price.

If you want to work at the intersection of technology, engineering, batteries, and sales, this is an opportunity to do it.

**What You'll Do**

**Develop New Business**

· Identify and pursue new opportunities for Maccor battery testing systems.

title: Group Accounting Manager, Data Center Infrastructure
description: Overview Empower every person and organization on the planet to achieve more. That’s what inspires us, drives our work and pushes us to challenge the status quo every day. Through our Cloud-first strategy, we strive to deliver solutions that are optimized for the world and enable customers to drive their business more successfully. We contribute to our company’s mission through delivering excellence in the Corporate Accounting organization. The team’s charter is to partner with a broad group of stakeholders to build out the end-to-end Microsoft Cloud Infrastructure, while optimizing investments and enabling accounting solutions that are scalable and mitigate risk. We are looking for a talented and motivated individual to help shape the future of our cloud infrastructure accounting systems and processes. As Group Accounting Manager, Data Center Infrastructure , you are a key member of the team and will be responsible for overseeing controllership for data center fixed assets and operations, including enabling process excellence, enhancing controls, providing accounting guidance for new arrangements and scaling a multi-billion dollar portfolio. This role is expected to operate with autonomy across organizational boundaries and drive transformation initiatives that directly improve controllership outcomes, including financial statement accuracy, error reduction, and financial risk mitigation. At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
